a: Never commit secrets; use env vars or a secret manager.
Vault/AWS SM/GCP SM store and rotate secrets centrally.
Prefer temporary credentials over long-lived static keys.
Rotate regularly and after any suspected leak.
Scan commits/PRs for accidental secret inserts.
Services get only the secrets they need.
Inject at runtime, not at image build time.
Rotate, revoke, review logs, and notify if customer data risk exists.
Non-sensitive config can be in files; secrets must be protected.
